status: STATIC CONTRACT REVIEW ONLY; NO EXPERIMENT EXECUTED

verified_contract.split: four spatial quadrants, 15 px screen collar; hidden 8-connected catalogue components touching the test region or collar are removed globally from visible context; train mask also purges the collar
verified_contract.catalogue_feature_rule: Each fold exposes `visible`; detector code must derive catalogue-dependent features only from this mask. The evaluator does not sandbox arbitrary feature builders, so the fold-visible-only rule must be tested/recorded by the lane code.
verified_contract.visible_fault_mask: `spatial_components` passes the fold `visible` grid as the exact catalogue mask to the shared metric before TP/FP credit; the 45-degree confirmation wrapper in `src/gemsdoe33/csht_transfer.py` delegates the same scoring/pooling/bootstrap primitives.
verified_contract.pooling_ci: Pool TPw/FPw/FNw before DTI; conditional paired spatial-block bootstrap 95% CI at 100 px / 10 km; fold-level scores are diagnostic, not the pooled estimate.
verified_contract.canary: SegmentHoldout.canary evaluates each supplied feature alone and both AUC orientations; any pooled or fold oriented AUC > 0.90 is flagged as suspected leakage, not proof of independence when it passes.
verified_contract.writer: scripts/submission_writer.py::write_pair delegates exact raster/ZIP output and on-disk checks to the pinned template; validates aligned shape and finite in-footprint [0,1], writes both zero-outside and NaN-outside variants, checks note length <=140, hashes saved bytes, and records that weekly slot authorization is false.
verified_contract.format_vs_science: Writer/validator format pass is not a scientific promotion decision or organizer portal-acceptance proof; uniqueness, holdout, run card, and separate selector remain independent gates.

limitations_and_noncanonical_paths: SegmentHoldout treats 8-connected raster components as a conservative proxy for fault segments; no expert trace-segment identifiers are present. It can hide a multi-branch connected component as one unit and cannot guarantee that disconnected pieces of a geological structure are hidden together.

The holdout provides masks and scoring but cannot mechanically prevent a detector from reading full labels or using a catalogue-derived feature built before the fold. Candidate feature construction must be fold-local and independently audited.
scripts/evaluate_holdout.py is an orchestration runner for frozen A33-L1/A33-R2 work, not a generic new-hypothesis CLI; its default path and experiment flags were not invoked.

vendor/gems57 is a separate historical G57 lane implementation (`gems57-pooled-hide-v2`) with its own evaluator/writer contracts and no vendor/gems24_template-style SOURCE.json. It is not silently substituted for the exact pinned GEMSDOE24 template. Its historical run records retain implementation hashes.

The locally implemented diagonal confirmation split uses the pinned GEMSDOE24 metric, tile attribution, pooling and bootstrap functions, but has separate split construction and must remain explicitly documented as such.

The pinned evaluator's summary field `n_unique_withheld_components` is currently set to the total input-catalogue component count (3,199 locally), not the unique components actually withheld. This is a metadata bug, not a DTI arithmetic input; historical cards lack per-fold IDs, so do not repeat 3,199 as a held-out count. Logged as IR-33-20261029-HOLDOUT-COUNT-01.
